revision_analysis_status: exploratory reviewer driven correction; not a preregistered analysis
units: raw outcome points per raw predictor point; W and B use same predictor unit
conditional_inference: Observed reporter-pool means and complete-case selections are held fixed in replicate regression inference; no population class-mean or latent-measurement-error variance is propagated
equation: Y_ij = a + beta_W (X_ij - mean_j X) + beta_B mean_j X + controls + error; contextual coefficient = beta_B-beta_W
group_mean: unweighted full valid construct-reporting pool before outcome/covariate listwise deletion
uncertainty_note: cluster inference/replicate weights address dependence/design, not latent aggregate measurement error

source_cleaning.duplicate_rule: Filter valid ID/school/class/grade rows before deduplication; assert no model-field conflict within eligible IDs.
source_cleaning.historical_gender_error: Original 1/2 filter excluded all male0 respondents; corrected before current analysis.

ECLS.sampling_weight_status: C7PW0 current parent+child survey weight chosen because W8SESL is parent-derived; C7CW0 child-only weight sensitivity; prior-response/complete-case selection not repaired by weights
ECLS.historical_weight_error: Original C7WEIGHT-weighted analysis withdrawn: provider C7WEIGHT is child body weight in pounds, not a sampling weight.
ECLS.historical_SES_error: Original extractor discarded all negative numbers; valid negative W8SESL values now retained, with only provider codes -7/-8/-9 removed.

participant_description.gender_coding: provider GENDER1male/2female, descriptive only; not an eligibility criterion

ECLS.outcome: official provider C7SDQINT eighth-grade self-reported internalizing problems composite, eight negative problem items, valid1–4, higher=more problems; use provided score directly with no invented missing-item threshold
ECLS.historical_mixed_outcome: internalizing_score is the old researcher-defined mean of two SDQ and three NELS items, >=4of5; retained only for measurement sensitivity
ECLS.measurement_decision: Official outcome selected 7 October 2026 before seeing reanalysis results because of formal scoring/content coverage, not association strength
ECLS.uncertainty_scope: JK2 regression intervals condition on observed unweighted reporter means and complete-case set; school bootstrap conditions on those means and resamples current schools, not original kindergarten PSUs.
ECLS.predictor: mean C7CLSFR/C7CLSLIK/C7CLSFEL/C7CLSOTH/C7CLSCAR valid1–5 >=4 of5; English-class grouping J71CLASS nested within S7_ID
